svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="publishing-workflow" name="From idea to published article"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="From idea to published article" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="idea" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Idea / calendar item
(Suggested -> Approved)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="20" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="draft" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Draft in the editor
(Visual or Markdown)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="260" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="review" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Status: review" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="140" x="480" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pub" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Publish
(button or
scheduled)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="140" x="660" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="live" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Published
sitemap, feeds, IndexNow" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="900" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ai" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="AI draft
(SEO agent or News desk)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="260" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="queue" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Review queue
(diff, notes)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="140" x="480" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="approve" parent="1" style="rhombus;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Approve?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="140" x="660" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reject" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Rejected / revise
(nothing changes)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="200" x="900" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="idea" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="draft" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="draft" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="review" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="review" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="pub" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="pub" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="live" value="person"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="ai" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="queue" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="queue" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="approve" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="approve" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="live" value="approve = publish + submit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="approve" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="reject" value="no"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
